# VR-1: Input-Up / Output-Down Coupling Within Animals

## Overview

This notebook tests whether the glutamatergic input-limb elevation and MeA–BST GABAergic output-limb suppression move together **within each animal** — the single result that licenses a coupled circuit disinhibition sentence for the olfactory–amygdalar chemosensory relay (including its vomeronasal-recipient nodes). All tests use per-animal aggregates (n = 6 / group); effect sizes with confidence intervals are primary.

## Background

Group-level MAST and D-SPIN results suggested WildR elevates glutamatergic MeA/COAp input programs while suppressing MeA–BST GABA programs. If that is one coupled circuit event, the two limbs should covary within animals. If they are independent effects that share a nucleus, they will not. This experiment does **not** re-run DE or D-SPIN; it reuses existing hit catalogues and per-animal program `h`.

::: {.fig-caption}
[**Figure 1.**]{.fig-num} Per-animal input-limb signature score vs MeA–BST GABA output-limb mean `h` (n = 12). Colour encodes microbiome group. Under coupled disinhibition, WildR should sit high-input / low-output with a negative Spearman correlation.
:::

::: {.takeaways}
**Key takeaways**

- Headline result is **per-animal separation on `D`** and **Cliff's δ with CI**, not a p-value.
- A negative input–output Spearman supports push–pull coupling; separation without correlation supports parallel modulation.
- No separation on `D` retires the coupled-circuit sentence — a valid negative result at this n.
:::

[Source: cell `cell-fig-scatter`](#cell-fig-scatter){.provenance}

# Code & Provenance {.code-appendix}

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| eval: !expr run_analysis

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(glue)
  library(Matrix)
  library(jsonlite)
})

source(file.path(wkdir, "notebooks/R_scripts/vr_relay_helpers.R"))
paths <- vr_paths(wkdir)
```

```{r}
#| label: cell-build-signature
#| eval: !expr run_analysis

mast <- load_mast_hits(paths = paths) %>%
  filter(tissue == "AMY", !excluded_gene) %>%
  filter(chain_position %in% c("1", "2", "3", "4")) %>%
  filter(grepl("Glut|IT |COAp|MEA Slc17a7|LA-BLA|MEA-COA", supertype_name))

# Catalogue of 243×27 not on disk: multi-hit WildR-UP (≥2) + expected core
pos_counts <- mast %>%
  filter(direction == "WildR-UP") %>%
  count(gene, name = "n_hits")
expected_core <- c("Eps8l1", "Zbtb16", "Hdac9", "Trpm3", "Rasa1")
sig_pos <- unique(c(
  intersect(expected_core, pos_counts$gene),
  pos_counts %>% filter(n_hits >= 2) %>% pull(gene)
))
sig_neg <- intersect(
  "Itpkb",
  mast %>% filter(direction == "SPF-UP") %>% pull(gene) %>% unique()
)

sig_info <- list(
  genes_pos = sig_pos,
  genes_neg = sig_neg,
  n_pos = length(sig_pos),
  n_neg = length(sig_neg)
)
jsonlite::write_json(sig_info, file.path(tbl_dir, "VR1_signature_genes.json"),
                     pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: cell-score-input
#| eval: !expr run_analysis

# Python subprocess scoring — reticulate conda probe is broken on this cluster
glut_labels <- c(
  "CS20230722_SUPT_0039", "CS20230722_SUPT_0040", "CS20230722_SUPT_0041",
  "CS20230722_SUPT_0042", "CS20230722_SUPT_0055", "CS20230722_SUPT_0056",
  "CS20230722_SUPT_0057", "CS20230722_SUPT_0058", "CS20230722_SUPT_0061",
  "CS20230722_SUPT_0507"
)

cell_scores <- bind_rows(lapply(glut_labels, function(lab) {
  score_unit_via_python(lab, sig_pos, sig_neg, paths = paths)
}))
write_csv(cell_scores, file.path(tbl_dir, "VR1_cell_scores.csv"))

# Equal-weight across available glut supertypes, then mean per animal
input_eq <- cell_scores %>%
  group_by(animal, group, supertype_label) %>%
  summarise(score_signed = mean(score_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
            score_pos_only = mean(score_pos_only, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_cells = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(animal, group) %>%
  summarise(
    input_score = mean(score_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    input_score_pos_only = mean(score_pos_only, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_supertypes = n(),
    n_cells_total = sum(n_cells),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

input_w <- cell_scores %>%
  group_by(animal, group) %>%
  summarise(
    input_score_cellwt = mean(score_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

input_animal <- input_eq %>% left_join(input_w, by = c("animal", "group"))
```

```{r}
#| label: cell-output-h
#| eval: !expr run_analysis

gaba <- gaba_output_programs()
h_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(gaba)), function(i) {
  read_dspin_unit_h("AMY", gaba$supertype_label[i], gaba$program_id[i],
                    which = "absolute", paths = paths) %>%
    mutate(key = paste0(gaba$supertype_label[i], "_", gaba$program_id[i]))
})
h_long <- bind_rows(h_list)

output_wide <- h_long %>%
  select(animal, group, key, h) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = key, values_from = h) %>%
  rename(
    output_0338_P10 = CS20230722_SUPT_0338_P10,
    output_0355_P5 = CS20230722_SUPT_0355_P5,
    output_0359_P6 = CS20230722_SUPT_0359_P6
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    output_score_mean = rowMeans(across(starts_with("output_")), na.rm = TRUE),
    gaba_sign_agree = (
      sign(output_0338_P10) == sign(output_0355_P5) &
        sign(output_0355_P5) == sign(output_0359_P6)
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: cell-tbl-scores
#| eval: !expr run_analysis

per_animal <- input_animal %>%
  inner_join(output_wide, by = c("animal", "group")) %>%
  mutate(
    z_input = as.numeric(scale(input_score)),
    z_output = as.numeric(scale(output_score_mean)),
    D = z_input - z_output
  )

write_csv(per_animal, scores_csv)
```

```{r}
#| label: cell-tbl-results
#| eval: !expr run_analysis

sep <- complete_separation(per_animal$D, per_animal$group, higher = "WildR")
cd <- cliffs_delta(
  per_animal$D[per_animal$group == "WildR"],
  per_animal$D[per_animal$group == "SPF"],
  n_boot = 10000L
)
wx <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(
  D ~ group, data = per_animal, exact = FALSE
))
sp <- spearman_ci(per_animal$input_score, per_animal$output_score_mean, n_boot = 5000L)

# Depth covariates
cov_umi <- tryCatch({
  cell_scores %>%
    group_by(animal) %>%
    summarise(med_umi = median(median_umi_proxy, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    right_join(per_animal, by = "animal")
}, error = function(e) per_animal %>% mutate(med_umi = NA_real_))

lines <- c(
  "# VR-1 results",
  "",
  "## Headline (decision rule)",
  "",
  sprintf("- Per-animal separation on `D`: **%d / %d** WildR exceed all SPF.",
          sep$n_exceed_all, sep$n_hi),
  sprintf("- Cliff's δ (WildR vs SPF on `D`): **%.3f** (95%% bootstrap CI %.3f – %.3f).",
          cd$delta, cd$ci_low, cd$ci_high),
  sprintf("- Spearman(input, output) across 12 animals: **ρ = %.3f** (CI %.3f – %.3f).",
          sp$rho, sp$ci_low, sp$ci_high),
  sprintf("- Wilcoxon rank-sum p (not headline): %.4g.", wx$p.value),
  "",
  "## Branch",
  "",
  if (isTRUE(sep$complete) || (sep$n_exceed_all >= 5 && isTRUE(sp$rho < 0))) {
    "**Decision:** complete/near-complete separation on `D` plus negative input–output correlation → coupled circuit disinhibition licensed. Proceed to VR-2."
  } else if (sep$n_exceed_all >= 5 && !(isTRUE(sp$rho < 0))) {
    "**Decision:** separation on `D` without negative correlation → parallel modulation; 'net disinhibition' OK, 'one coupled circuit' not."
  } else {
    "**Decision:** no clear separation on `D` → retire the coupled-circuit sentence (valuable negative)."
  },
  "",
  "## Sensitivity",
  "",
  "- Recompute excluding `Zbtb16` and with each GABA program alone — see `VR1_sensitivity.csv`.",
  "",
  "## Technical covariates",
  "",
  "- Correlate raw input/output scores with per-animal median UMI and nuclei recovered; report in sensitivity table.",
  "",
  "## Signature",
  "",
  sprintf("- Positive genes (n=%d): %s", length(sig_pos), paste(sig_pos, collapse = ", ")),
  sprintf("- Signed-negative genes (n=%d): %s", length(sig_neg), paste(sig_neg, collapse = ", ")),
  "- Scoring method: `scanpy.tl.score_genes` on per-unit `raw_counts.h5ad` (detection-matched controls).",
  "- Aggregation: equal weight across glutamatergic AMY relay supertypes; cell-count-weighted as sensitivity.",
  "- Comparison type: **between-animal** WildR vs SPF on within-animal `D` (each animal contributes one AMY well).",
  ""
)
write_md(results_md, lines)

# Sensitivity table
sens_rows <- list()
# no Zbtb16
if ("Zbtb16" %in% sig_pos) {
  pos2 <- setdiff(sig_pos, "Zbtb16")
  cs2 <- bind_rows(lapply(glut_labels, function(lab) {
    score_unit_via_python(lab, pos2, sig_neg, paths = paths)
  }))
  in2 <- cs2 %>%
    group_by(animal, group, supertype_label) %>%
    summarise(s = mean(score_signed, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(animal, group) %>%
    summarise(input_score = mean(s, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  pa2 <- in2 %>% inner_join(output_wide, by = c("animal", "group")) %>%
    mutate(D = as.numeric(scale(input_score)) - as.numeric(scale(output_score_mean)))
  cd2 <- cliffs_delta(pa2$D[pa2$group == "WildR"], pa2$D[pa2$group == "SPF"])
  sens_rows[[length(sens_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
    setting = "exclude_Zbtb16", cliff_delta = cd2$delta,
    ci_low = cd2$ci_low, ci_high = cd2$ci_high
  )
}
for (col in c("output_0338_P10", "output_0355_P5", "output_0359_P6")) {
  pa3 <- per_animal %>%
    mutate(D = as.numeric(scale(input_score)) - as.numeric(scale(.data[[col]])))
  cd3 <- cliffs_delta(pa3$D[pa3$group == "WildR"], pa3$D[pa3$group == "SPF"])
  sens_rows[[length(sens_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
    setting = paste0("output_only_", col), cliff_delta = cd3$delta,
    ci_low = cd3$ci_low, ci_high = cd3$ci_high
  )
}
write_csv(bind_rows(sens_rows), file.path(tbl_dir, "VR1_sensitivity.csv"))
```
